name: ends-from-outside
description: Ends from outside TSB, as the worker reports them (session model §9 E5, §12–§13; decision 5.45). The target sends SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_CLOSE (RFC 4254 §5.3) on session A's channel without the core asking — its shell exited, its user logged out, the device's own exec-timeout fired: channel_closed by target, and A ends terminated / target_closed while B and C live on (Contract §15.2). Then the target sends SSH_MSG_DISCONNECT (RFC 4253 §11.1): connection_lost with cause target_disconnect, and B and C end terminated / target_closed. Our end of the TCP connection gone (cause transport) or link_timeout (cause keepalive_timeout) ends every listed session terminated / connection_lost (connection-lost-lists-sessions). Attached clients are closed 4012. reason is free text for the log: no exit status is read — optional in RFC 4254 §6.10 and unreliable on network gear — and nothing matches prompts (Contract §6). A collected run must show an end by the target (exit a shell on the target while collecting), and every session ended from outside TSB must be audited terminated with the reason its event gives.

messages.note: SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_CLOSE from the target: A ends terminated / target_closed; B and C live on
SSH_MSG_DISCONNECT from the target: B and C end terminated / target_closed
